macros.name: floatcontentscentre
macros.doc: As the macro names make clear, \floatcontentscentre will make all floats centred (for users speaking U.S. English, the alternative spelling \floatcontentscenter is also available).

macros.name: listofschemes
macros.doc: To match the \listoffigures and \listoftables macros provided by the LaTeX kernel, chemscheme provides a \listofschemes command. This works in the same way as the kernel commands, with the default text stored in the macro \listschemename.

macros.name: schemename
macros.doc: \schemename contains the text used in scheme captions (by default Scheme).

macros.name: schemerefmarker
macros.doc: When using automatic substitution mode, the “marker” text to be searched for is stored as \schemerefmarker, which has default value TMP.
